text: Mới lấy Model Y về, insurance quote em thấy hơi cao, $265/tháng. Có ai đang chạy Tesla ở CA share rate với hãng nào đang xài không? Ai có rate tốt recommend giúp em với!
comment_source_reason: Tesla owners in California comparing insurance quotes draws other EV owners sharing their own rate/renewal experience (situational leads) and insurance agents/brokers pitching auto quotes — a natural source of consumer leads and competitor pitches for an insurance-agent client.
